specific_objectives: 33.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to state various terminology used and differentiate between Error, Mistake, Negligence and Violation, flight safety, near miss box and accident reporting procedure.

practical: Review of accident reporting forms and terminology definitions; Safety: Ensure no sensitive operational data is disclosed; Supervision: Instructor monitors form completion accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of accident reporting?
Can you list three types of safety incidents?
Why is immediate reporting critical for flight safety?

development.content:
Definition of Flight Safety
Distinction between Error and Mistake
Understanding Negligence and Violation
Concept of Near Miss Box
Initial Reporting Steps

Detailed Accident Reporting Procedure
Classification of Accident Severity
Role of Safety Committee
Documentation Requirements
Submission Timelines

Review of Reporting Forms
Common Reporting Errors
Corrective Actions
Follow-up Procedures
Confidentiality Protocols

summary_questions: Differentiate between a mistake and a violation in reporting context.
What specific information must be included in a near miss report?
Explain the immediate steps required after an accident occurs.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the accident reporting procedure to be discussed in LP 02 regarding Key Organization roles.
